sentences.zh: 你看了我们在Showtime播出的全部十季了吗？

sentences.en: Shameless.
sentences.zh: 《无耻之徒》。

sentences.en: Shameless.
sentences.zh: 《无耻之徒》。

sentences.en: Welcome to the show.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到节目。

sentences.en: How do you and Will know each other, Tom?
sentences.zh: 汤姆，你和威尔是怎么认识的？

sentences.en: Just hanging around in New York, out on Long Island.
sentences.zh: 就是在纽约和长岛附近闲逛时认识的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 噢，没错。

sentences.en: We originally met through our mutual friend many years ago through Jimmy Buffett.
sentences.zh: 我们最初是多年前通过共同的朋友吉米·巴菲特认识的。

sentences.en: Jimmy and Jane Buffett introduced us back in the day.
sentences.zh: 吉米和简·巴菲特当年把我们介绍给彼此。

sentences.en: Tom's good friend, may he rest in peace.
sentences.zh: 汤姆的好友，愿他安息。

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm sorry about your loss there.
sentences.zh: 是啊，对于你的损失我深表遗憾。

sentences.en: The great Jimmy Buffett.
sentences.zh: 伟大的吉米·巴菲特。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And who was, Jimmy, one of the things he did was he brought a lot of people together
sentences.zh: 吉米做过的一件事就是把很多人聚在一起，

sentences.en: and introduced a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 并把很多人介绍给彼此。

sentences.en: Am I right about that, Tom?
sentences.zh: 我说得对吗，汤姆？

sentences.en: Yeah, he sure did.
sentences.zh: 是的，他确实如此。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: How did you, Tom, how'd you meet Jimmy?
sentences.zh: 汤姆，你是怎么认识吉米的？

sentences.en: I met Jimmy in the basement of a bar called JP's in Manhattan in the 70s.
sentences.zh: 我是在70年代曼哈顿一家叫JP's的酒吧地下室里遇到吉米的。

sentences.en: It was like, you know, at 5 a.m.
sentences.zh: 当时大概是凌晨五点，

sentences.en: you'd open up one of those Bilko doors or 8 a.m.
sentences.zh: 你推开那些比尔科门，或者早上八点，

sentences.en: and walk out in the sunlight like a vampire.
sentences.zh: 像吸血鬼一样走进阳光里。

sentences.en: But he would hang out there.
sentences.zh: 但他会待在那里。

sentences.en: It was like sort of a music industry hangout.
sentences.zh: 那儿算是音乐圈人士的聚集地。

sentences.en: So I met him there in 1977.
sentences.zh: 所以我是在1977年在那儿认识他的。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And we just, you know, would hang out and trips.
sentences.zh: 我们当时就是，你知道，经常一起出去玩，去旅行。

sentences.en: I would travel with him a lot.
sentences.zh: 我经常和他一起旅行。

sentences.en: He liked to go to, he liked to travel.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢去各地，他喜欢旅行。

sentences.en: And that was especially good, especially after he bought a jet.
sentences.zh: 尤其是在他买了喷气式飞机之后，那感觉特别棒。

sentences.en: Yeah, was he flying planes back then?
sentences.zh: 是吗，他那时候就自己开飞机了吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, he could fly all kinds of planes.
sentences.zh: 是的，他什么飞机都能开。

sentences.en: The Jimmy Jets.
sentences.zh: 吉米的喷气机。

sentences.en: Yeah, he was very serious about it.
sentences.zh: 没错，他对此非常认真。

sentences.en: He could fly sea planes, you know, all kinds of big fancy ones as well.
sentences.zh: 他能开水上飞机，你知道，各种大型豪华飞机也都能开。

sentences.en: And, Tom, he had a few, Jimmy also crashed a few planes, didn't he?
sentences.zh: 而且，汤姆，他有好几架，吉米也撞毁过几架飞机，对吧？

sentences.en: He did, he crashed.
sentences.zh: 他确实坠机了。

sentences.en: He landed in Nantucket and sort of flipped it over.
sentences.zh: 他在楠塔基特岛降落时，飞机翻了过来。

sentences.en: And that was one, and there was other instances of malfeasance.
sentences.zh: 那是一次，还有其他一些违规操作的例子。

sentences.en: Yeah, I remember one time when we were, I told that story when they did that show at the Hollywood Bowl
sentences.zh: 是啊，我记得有一次，我讲过那个故事，当时他们在好莱坞露天剧场举办演出，

sentences.en: in honor of Jimmy and I told the story about he was going to do takeoff and landings on this little island.
sentences.zh: 为了纪念吉米，我讲了他要在那个小岛上进行起降训练的故事。

sentences.en: And he said, what are you, I said, what are you doing this morning?
sentences.zh: 他问我，我说，你今天早上打算做什么？

sentences.en: And he goes, I got to go get certified, I'm doing takeoffs and landings, do you want to go?
sentences.zh: 他说，我得去考个证，我要做起降训练，你想去吗？

sentences.en: And I go, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我说，好啊。

sentences.en: And then he left the room and Jane turned to me and she goes, dude, he's crashed like three planes,
sentences.zh: 然后他离开了房间，简转过头对我说，老兄，他已经摔了三架飞机了，

sentences.en: you're not getting on.
sentences.zh: 你可别上他的飞机。

sentences.en: Oh my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: The key word there is training.
sentences.zh: 关键词是“训练”。

sentences.en: Do you want to come for training?
sentences.zh: 你想去参加训练吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不想。

sentences.en: So, Tom, I want to go all the way back.
sentences.zh: 那么，汤姆，我想从头聊起。

sentences.en: By the way, Tom's got a book that we're going to get into Tom's book in a second
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，汤姆写了一本书，我们待会儿会聊到这本书，

sentences.en: because I read it a while ago and it's phenomenal.
sentences.zh: 因为我前阵子读了，非常精彩。

sentences.en: But I will, it's called Unplugged, which is fantastic, which is, I think, out now, right, Tom?
sentences.zh: 书名叫《Unplugged》，棒极了，我想现在应该已经出版了吧，汤姆？

sentences.en: It comes out November 18.
sentences.zh: 11月18日出版。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, but, you know, again, we've known each other a little bit over the years,
sentences.zh: 所以，虽然我们这些年来认识有一阵子了，

sentences.en: but I read your book.
sentences.zh: 但我还是读了你的书。

sentences.en: So, Tom, walk us through, and I wasn't joking when I said you started,
sentences.zh: 那么，汤姆，给我们讲讲吧，我刚才说你开始做的时候可不是在开玩笑，

sentences.en: you started a clothing company in Afghanistan in India.
sentences.zh: 你在阿富汗和印度创办了一家服装公司。

sentences.en: Yeah, I want to know how and why.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想知道是怎么回事，为什么要这么做。

sentences.en: How is one able to do that?
sentences.zh: 一个人是怎么做到这一点的？

sentences.en: Well, let's see.
sentences.zh: 嗯，让我想想。

sentences.en: I was, I had been working in an ad agency in New York.
sentences.zh: 当时我在纽约的一家广告公司工作。

sentences.en: I got assigned to Charmin Toilet Paper.
sentences.zh: 我被分配负责查敏卫生纸的广告。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: A tough account.
sentences.zh: 那可是个棘手的客户。

sentences.en: Working with Mr. Whipple.
sentences.zh: 还要和惠普尔先生一起工作。

sentences.en: And this, my old girlfriend was in Paris, Colm.
sentences.zh: 当时我前女友在巴黎，科尔姆。

sentences.en: I said, hey, you can't do that.
sentences.zh: 我说，嘿，你不能那样做。

sentences.en: Come with me.
sentences.zh: 跟我走吧。

sentences.en: We're going to cross the Sahara Desert.
sentences.zh: 我们要穿越撒哈拉沙漠。

sentences.en: And I quit my job.
sentences.zh: 于是我辞了职。

sentences.en: And a week later, I was on a plane.
sentences.zh: 一周后，我就上了飞机。

sentences.en: And I met her, and we traveled around.
sentences.zh: 我见到了她，我们一起四处旅行。

sentences.en: And then she left, and I kept going for a whole year.
sentences.zh: 后来她离开了，但我又继续旅行了一整年。

sentences.en: And at one point, I met some woman who said, you know,
sentences.zh: 有一次，我遇到一位女士，她说，你知道吗，

sentences.en: you've got to go to India.
sentences.zh: 你一定要去印度看看。

sentences.en: That's the greatest show on earth.
sentences.zh: 那是地球上最棒的表演。

sentences.en: So I did do that, and I ended up loving India and Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 于是我去了，结果我爱上了印度和阿富汗。

sentences.en: And I stayed for, I tried to figure out, how can I live here?
sentences.zh: 我待在那里，试图弄清楚，我该怎么在这里生活下去？

sentences.en: This is like living on a whole other planet back then.
sentences.zh: 那时的生活感觉就像在另一个星球上一样。

sentences.en: And what year-ish?
sentences.zh: 那是哪一年左右？

sentences.en: This is 1972.
So I stayed through 1979.
sentences.zh: 所以我一直待到了1979年。

sentences.en: I started a couple of businesses.
sentences.zh: 我创办了几家企业。

sentences.en: We would design and make clothes.
sentences.zh: 我们会设计并制作服装。

sentences.en: I mean, higher quality clothes we'd sell to Bloomingdale's and so forth.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们会把更高品质的服装卖给布鲁明戴尔百货公司之类的商场。

sentences.en: And it became a big business.
sentences.zh: 那成了一门大生意。

sentences.en: I mean, and I had a house in Delhi, and I was able to travel everywhere.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我在德里有栋房子，而且我能去任何地方旅行。

sentences.en: I was living like a pasha.
sentences.zh: 我过着像帕夏一样的生活。

sentences.en: It was wonderful, and then a bunch of bad things happened to me.
sentences.zh: 那段日子太美好了，后来我遇到了一连串倒霉事。

sentences.en: And not the least of which was Jimmy Carter put an embargo.
sentences.zh: 其中最糟糕的莫过于吉米·卡特实施了禁运。

sentences.en: It's sort of like what's going on today with the tariffs.
sentences.zh: 这有点像今天发生的关税问题。

sentences.en: There would be no more clothing imports from India.
sentences.zh: 印度服装将不再被允许进口。

sentences.en: And I had all this stuff in production.
sentences.zh: 而我当时还有一大堆货在生产线上。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: You know, it's a nightmare working there in those days.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那时候在那儿工作简直是场噩梦。

sentences.en: So I actually ended up smuggling three tons of stuff in from Canada.
sentences.zh: 所以我最后竟然从加拿大走私了三吨货进来。

sentences.en: Yeah, wait, wait, Tom.
sentences.zh: 等等，等等，汤姆。

sentences.en: Take us through that.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲那段经历。

sentences.en: So you get, by the way, this is like, so this before, obviously before the internet and all that stuff.
sentences.zh: 顺便问一下，这显然是在互联网和那些东西出现之前。

sentences.en: So you guys, this is all sort of phone calls, and everything takes a little bit longer.
sentences.zh: 所以你们当时全靠打电话，什么事都得花点时间。

sentences.en: And now you've got all these goods that you're sitting on, and you've got to get it into the States.
sentences.zh: 现在你手里压着这么多货，你得想办法把它弄进美国。

sentences.en: And so you decide what?
sentences.zh: 于是你决定怎么做？

sentences.en: Well, I had met in my years there all these smugglers, you know, sort of rife with drug smugglers.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我在那儿待的几年里认识了所有这些走私贩，你知道，那儿到处都是毒品走私犯。

sentences.en: And they would always say how easy it was to smuggle stuff into the United States.
sentences.zh: 他们总是说把东西走私进美国有多容易。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Just by putting it on a plane and just nobody checking?
sentences.zh: 就是直接装上飞机，根本没人检查？

sentences.en: Well, no, they would send stuff in shipments.
sentences.zh: 嗯，不，他们会通过货运发送东西。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: They would take stuff across borders.
sentences.zh: 他们会把东西运过边境。

sentences.en: But in this case, I was allowed to bring stuff legally into Canada.
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，我是被允许合法地把东西带进加拿大的。

sentences.en: And, you know, I figured, you know, if these long-haired goofballs could do it, I could do it.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我想如果这些留长发的傻瓜都能做到，我也能做到。

sentences.en: And I felt like I wasn't really committing a crime.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我并没有真正犯罪。

sentences.en: It was really foolish, I would admit.
sentences.zh: 我承认，这真的很愚蠢。

sentences.en: I mean, but I just want to get some money back.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我只是想挽回一些损失。

sentences.en: I felt I had really been ripped off by the government with no prior announcement or anything.
sentences.zh: 我觉得政府在没有任何预先通知的情况下就坑了我，我感觉自己被洗劫了。

sentences.en: So that was the end of my business.
sentences.zh: 所以我的生意就那样结束了。

sentences.en: And I also had my business in Afghanistan kind of vaporized because there had been a communist coup there.
sentences.zh: 而且我在阿富汗的生意也因为那里的共产主义政变而化为乌有了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But, Tom, can you – for a real soft Hollywood idiot like me, who any – this whole thing sounds just so foreign from anything I would ever imagine, let alone pursue.
sentences.zh: 但是，汤姆，你能——对于像我这种真正的软弱好莱坞白痴来说，这一切听起来跟我能想象到的任何事情都太遥远了，更别提去做了。

sentences.en: He won't go east of La Brea, put it that way, okay?
sentences.zh: 他连拉布雷亚大道以东都不去，这么说吧，行吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, it's just – forget it.
sentences.zh: 是啊，就是——算了吧。

sentences.en: Or south of the airport.
sentences.zh: 或者机场以南也不去。

sentences.en: What was your life like at that age, at that time, that gave you either the courage to have this wanderlust or maybe the opposite of courage?
sentences.zh: 你那个年纪、那个时候的生活是什么样的？是什么让你有了这种漫游癖，或者说，也许是与勇气相反的东西？

sentences.en: There was just stuff happening in your life.
sentences.zh: 你的生活中只是发生了一些事情。

sentences.en: It was like, fuck all this.
sentences.zh: 当时的感觉就是，去他妈的这一切。

sentences.en: I just want to go to the end of the earth for something completely new, something completely different because this ain't working.
sentences.zh: 我只想去天涯海角寻找一些全新的、完全不同的东西，因为现在的生活根本行不通。

sentences.en: Was it one of the two?
sentences.zh: 是这两种情况中的哪一种？

sentences.en: Yeah, it was more the latter.
sentences.zh: 是的，更多是后者。

sentences.en: I mean, I was – yeah, it was the 60s.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我当时——是的，那是60年代。

sentences.en: So, you know, there was a lot of alienation around.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，当时到处都弥漫着疏离感。

sentences.en: Freedom sounded like a good option.
sentences.zh: 自由听起来是个不错的选择。

sentences.en: I decided early on I didn't want to really have a mainstream kind of life.
sentences.zh: 我很早就决定我不想过那种主流生活。

sentences.en: I had taken a year off and sort of bartended around.
sentences.zh: 我休了一年假，到处打工当酒保。

sentences.en: But you had gotten your MBA, right?
sentences.zh: 但你当时已经拿到工商管理硕士学位了，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, I had an MBA.
sentences.zh: 是的，我拿到了工商管理硕士学位。

sentences.en: I did that.
sentences.zh: 我确实做到了。

sentences.en: That was a way to stay out of the draft in those days.
sentences.zh: 在那个年代，这是逃避征兵的一种方式。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then so it was – I just wanted to sort of leave out of the mainstream life.
sentences.zh: 所以当时的情况是——我只是想离开主流生活。

sentences.en: And it sounded very exotic and interesting to be living in a place so foreign.
sentences.zh: 而且生活在一个如此陌生的地方，听起来非常异国情调，也很有趣。

sentences.en: What was it about the mainstream life that just didn't feel something that you were attracted to,
sentences.zh: 主流生活有什么让你觉得不吸引你的地方吗？

sentences.en: especially given the fact that you had gone down this road of mainstream?
sentences.zh: 尤其是考虑到你已经走上了这条主流道路？

sentences.en: You got an MBA and, like, you're set.
sentences.zh: 你拿到了工商管理硕士学位，就像是，你已经准备好了。

sentences.en: You're ready.
sentences.zh: 你已经准备就绪了。

sentences.en: You put a huge time and financial investment into the mainstream.
sentences.zh: 你在主流社会投入了大量的时间和金钱。

sentences.en: And then you said, yeah, no, let's flip it.
sentences.zh: 然后你说，好吧，不，让我们彻底改变一下。

sentences.en: Let's go 180 this way.
sentences.zh: 让我们来个180度大转弯。

sentences.en: It wasn't fun.
sentences.zh: 那一点也不好玩。

sentences.en: Have you ever tried selling toilet paper?
sentences.zh: 你试过卖卫生纸吗？

sentences.en: I actually had one.
sentences.zh: 我确实做过一份工作。

sentences.en: And before that, I was on the G.I.
sentences.zh: 在那之前，我负责“特种部队”项目，

sentences.en: Joe account, which was like the war toy of the military industrial complex.
sentences.zh: 那是军工复合体的战争玩具。

sentences.en: It was a very alienated time.
sentences.zh: 那是一个非常疏离的时代。

sentences.en: A lot of people were quitting jobs and sort of trying to go off and do their own thing.
sentences.zh: 很多人都在辞职，试图去追求自己的事情。

sentences.en: So everything looked appealing at that point.
sentences.zh: 所以在那时，一切看起来都很有吸引力。

sentences.en: Everything looked appealing and it looked really exciting because I wasn't having any fun.
sentences.zh: 一切看起来都很有吸引力，而且看起来真的很令人兴奋，因为我当时一点也不快乐。

sentences.en: I felt like I needed to stretch out a bit.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我需要去拓展一下视野。

sentences.en: I'd been in school for, like, 18 years or something.
sentences.zh: 我已经在学校待了大概18年左右了。

sentences.en: So I was ready to go.
sentences.zh: 所以我准备好出发了。

sentences.en: And then I fell in love with this very foreign place.
sentences.zh: 然后我爱上了这个非常陌生的地方。

sentences.en: And in those days, it was really foreign, you know.
sentences.zh: 在那个年代，它真的很陌生，你知道的。

sentences.en: Also age, because if you're young, you're like, well, I might as well try it now.
sentences.zh: 还有年龄的原因，因为如果你还年轻，你会想，好吧，我不如现在就去尝试一下。

sentences.en: How old were you?
sentences.zh: 你当时多大？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I was 25, 26, you know.
sentences.zh: 我当时25、26岁，你知道的。

sentences.en: I mean, a young soul.
sentences.zh: 我是说，年轻的心灵。

sentences.en: If not now, when?
sentences.zh: 如果不是现在，那是什么时候呢？

sentences.en: That's, yeah.
sentences.zh: 确实，没错。

sentences.en: Yeah, I remember you sort of describe in the book when you first get to Morocco, when you're
sentences.zh: 是的，我记得你在书中描述过，当你第一次到达摩洛哥时，当你

sentences.en: still with, you're traveling with your friend, your girlfriend, and just like meeting these
